BOARD AND ORS. A V. CYRIAC THOMAS AND ORS. SEPTEMBER I 0, 2002 [SYED SHAH MOHAMMED QUADRI AND S.N. VARIAVA JJ.] B Kera/a Land Reforms Act, 1964: land ceiling~A Christian in erstwhile State of Travancore Cochin died C in 1958 leaving behind sons and daughters-Land sold by his daughters included all children of the deceased inherited the land thereunder-Accordingly, the sale deeds of lands executed by the daughters of their shares were valid-Therefore, the land covered by D the sales could not be added to the holding of the declarant son-Indian Succession Act, 1925-Succession-Part-B
Decision Date : 10-09-2002 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 333/1998 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
